Ce script ajoute la seccion censal au panel

/!\\ Pas besoin de relancer car c'est bon la seccion censal a été ajoutée au panle déjà !!

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(arrow)
library(stringi)
```

```{r}
ARCHIVE <- "/home/onyxia/work/UGR/Panel_Hogares.rar"  
OUT     <- "~/work/UGR/panel_income_2016_2023"

bkt   <- s3_bucket("mperier", endpoint_override = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"))
PANEL <- setDT(read_parquet(bkt$path("panel_hogares/panel_persons_2016_2023_sec.parquet")))
```

```{r}

#system("sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y unar unrar")
#Sys.which(c("unrar", "lsar"))   # les deux doivent renvoyer un chemin

members <- system2("unrar", c("lb", shQuote(ARCHIVE)), stdout = TRUE)
iden_member <- function(y) {
  m <- grep(sprintf("(^|/|\\\\)_?1?1_IDEN_?%d(\\.txt)?$", y), members, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(m) != 1) stop(y, " : ", length(m), " membres trouvés")
  m
}


read_seccion <- function(y, chunk = 500000L) {
  con <- pipe(sprintf("unrar p -inul %s %s", shQuote(ARCHIVE), shQuote(iden_member(y))), open = "r")
  on.exit(close(con))
  parts <- list(); k <- 0L
  repeat {
    x <- readLines(con, n = chunk, warn = FALSE, encoding = "latin1")
    if (!length(x)) break
    x <- stri_replace_last_regex(x, "\r$", "")
    x <- x[nzchar(x)]
    k <- k + 1L
    parts[[k]] <- data.table(IDENPER = as.numeric(stri_sub(x, 1, length = 11)),
                             IDENHOG = as.numeric(stri_sub(x, 12, length = 11)),
                             SECCION = stri_trim_both(stri_sub(x, 132, length = 10)))
  }
  d <- rbindlist(parts); d[, year := y][]
}

SEC <- rbindlist(lapply(2016:2023, function(y) { message(y); read_seccion(y) }))
SEC[, .(n = .N, idenper_na = sum(is.na(IDENPER))), by = year][order(year)]
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
# 1. Jointure
SEC[SECCION == "", SECCION := NA_character_]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(SEC, by = c("IDENPER", "year")))
PANEL[, SECCION := NULL]  # au cas où une ancienne tentative l'aurait ajoutée
PANEL[SEC, on = .(IDENPER, year), `:=`(SECCION = i.SECCION, hog_ok = IDENHOG == i.IDENHOG)]

# 2. Contrôles
PANEL[, .(n = .N, sec_na = mean(is.na(SECCION)), hog_ok = mean(hog_ok, na.rm = TRUE),
          n_sec = uniqueN(SECCION),
          coh_cmun = mean(substr(SECCION, 1, 5) == paste0(CPRO, CMUN), na.rm = TRUE)),
      by = year][order(year)]
PANEL[, hog_ok := NULL]
saveRDS(PANEL, file.path(OUT, "panel_persons_2016_2023.rds"))
```

```{r enregistrer}
stopifnot("SECCION" %in% names(PANEL))

tbl <- arrow::arrow_table(PANEL)
tbl$metadata$r <- NULL
arrow::write_parquet(tbl, bkt$path("panel_hogares/panel_persons_2016_2023_sec.parquet"),
                     compression = "zstd")
rm(tbl)
```

```{r}
chk <- arrow::read_parquet(bkt$path("panel_hogares/panel_persons_2016_2023_sec.parquet"),
                           col_select = c("year", "SECCION"))
data.table::setDT(chk)[, .N, by = year][order(year)]
```
